_comment: Curated, user-facing release highlights for the in-app 'What's New' popup and the changelog page's highlights column. Keyed by version (no leading v). Newest entries are shown first; the popup surfaces every entry newer than the user's last-seen version. Tone mirrors the Discord patch notes: short, friendly, one line per highlight. Maintain alongside each release (see the release checklist in .kiro/steering/dev-agent.md). Keep the raw per-session technical detail in docs/changelog.md; this file is the curated highlights only.

versions.title: Stability fix
highlights: Internal test-reliability fix — no change to the app itself.

versions.title: Faster, more reliable refreshes
highlights: Refreshes no longer hang silently on a stalled request — every pull is now time-bounded and retried.
Large-league and offseason refreshes are quicker: redundant data renders are cached and skipped.
A per-league lock prevents overlapping refreshes from stacking up on the same league.

versions.title: Hitter evaluation fixes & league analytics
highlights: Hitter grades re-centered on offense — weak-hitting catchers no longer float up and strong-hitting center fielders no longer sink.
Prospect value now keeps a player's already-developed ability as a floor instead of discounting the whole projection.
New player-page positional bell curve shows where a player ranks among his position's peers.
The league Advanced-stats tab adds single-stat distributions and customizable scatter views.
